Your mission is to carefully sort and arrange these gifts to suit each child's preferences, all while keeping an eye on the clock and ensuring that each gift is delivered before time runs out. The game's controls are incredibly responsive, allowing you to focus on the puzzles at hand rather than struggling with clunky navigation.
